advisor.workspaceDisabledNotice: All explicit workspace disables, regardless of who disabled them. Read-only snapshot of this workspace's saved VS Code state; global-only disables and legacy Advisor restrictions are excluded. VS Code may delay saving recent changes: refresh again later. Open Extensions to enable an extension yourself.
advisor.workspaceDisabledEmpty: No explicit workspace disables in the saved snapshot. Recent changes may not have been saved yet.
advisor.workspaceDisabledUnsupported: The exact saved workspace list is unavailable in this environment. An empty or general disabled list would not prove workspace enablement.
advisor.aiNotice: Scan sends bounded project file names, structure and available extension metadata to your current IVOL provider/model. No file contents are read. AI suggests candidates and feature trade-offs, not measured CPU usage. Open an extension and choose Disable (Workspace) yourself; Advisor never changes extension enablement.
advisor.aiPlatform: This analysis uses the VS Code extension inventory and Extensions panel. Native JetBrains plugins are not supported; no VS Code actions will be simulated.
advisor.aiRunning: Analyzing in the background (up to 90 seconds). You can go back to chat. When finished, a notification will appear and the Advisor lightbulb will light up. Keep this panel open; reloading or closing it stops tracking the scan.
advisor.ready: Advisor analysis finished. Recommendations are ready to review.
advisor.aiTimeout: The request timed out. Any pending analysis cancellation was requested. You can retry.
advisor.aiUsage: Model: {{model}} · Input: {{input}} tokens · Output: {{output}} tokens · Reported cost: ${{cost}} (— means unavailable)
advisor.aiCoverage: Observed files: {{files}} · Available extensions: {{count}}. Disabled installations may not appear in the public inventory.
advisor.aiEmpty: No matching AI recommendations. This does not prove that every extension is necessary.
advisor.title: Advisor
advisor.analysisIncomplete: Scan incomplete: missing markers do not prove an extension is unused.
advisor.workspaceRequired: Analysis requires one open, trusted workspace folder. Multi-root workspaces need manual review.
